cases.prompt: Implement behavioral tests for the supplied skill. Do not run agent evaluations.
cases.context: The target skill summarizes a supplied incident log. It must distinguish observed events from hypotheses, name missing evidence, and leave source files unchanged. A prior failure reported a guessed cause as confirmed. Log: '09:00 request timed out. 09:02 retry succeeded.' No root cause was observed.
expectations: Creates a structurally valid tests/cases.json suite with stable IDs and observable expectations.
Includes a regression case distinguishing the observed timeout and successful retry from an unproven root cause.
Includes a boundary such as missing evidence or unchanged source without requiring particular generated wording.
Runs only free structural validation; starts no tested-agent or grading sessions and does not report behavioral passes.

cases.prompt: Add a case for this observed scope failure, preserving the existing case. Do not evaluate the cases yet.
cases.context: The supplied target skill analyzes selected text without changing it. The observed failure was an unsolicited whole-document rewrite when asked to analyze one paragraph.

files.target/SKILL.md:
---
name: paragraph-analyzer
description: Analyze selected paragraphs. Use when asked to propose text improvements.
---

# Paragraph analysis

Read only the selected paragraph, propose cuts, and leave the source unchanged.
files.target/tests/cases.json: {"schema_version":1,"cases":[{"id":"PARA-001","prompt":"Analyze this paragraph.","context":"The command writes CSV.","expectations":["Preserves the concrete CSV fact."]}]}

expectations: Preserves PARA-001 and its meaning, assigning a new ID to the new scope regression case.
Supplies selected and surrounding text so the new case can detect an unwanted broader rewrite.
Keeps the correct answer and rubric separate from the tested agent's prompt and context.
Leaves the target skill's behavior unchanged and does not execute evaluations.

cases.prompt: Add a deletion-only diff case for a skill that reviews a change without modifying it. Validate the suite without invoking an agent.
cases.context: The reviewer must identify the deletion of the only documented startup command. Before: README.md contains 'Run app --serve'. After: README.md is absent. There are no other changed files.
expectations: Represents the deleted path in before and uses an empty after map, rather than an empty README file that was not the observed change.
Includes expectations for the lost startup instruction and source preservation.
Uses the structural checker and distinguishes validation success from a behavioral test verdict.

cases.prompt: Implement script tests for the supplied normalize skill. Capture the reported trailing-whitespace defect and run the tests, but do not fix the implementation or start agent evaluations.
cases.context: normalize.ps1 must remove whitespace at both ends and preserve interior spaces. The observed failure: input '  alpha beta  ' returns 'alpha beta  '.

files.target/SKILL.md:
---
name: normalize-text
description: Normalize whitespace. Use when trimming supplied text.
---

# Text normalization

Run scripts/normalize.ps1 to trim whitespace at both ends, preserving interior spaces.

follow_up: Now fix the script to trim both ends and run its script tests again against the edited implementation. Do not start behavior evaluations.
expectations: Creates tests/test-normalize.ps1 that executes the real normalize script and asserts boundary trimming and preservation of interior spaces.
Actually runs the test and records the trailing-whitespace regression as failed before the follow-up, without weakening assertions or changing the implementation prematurely.
After the follow-up edit, reruns the script tests against the final version and bases its final verdict on that run rather than the earlier result.
Starts no behavioral evaluation or paid grader and keeps script results distinct from case-structure checks.
Creates scripts/run-tests.ps1 and uses that entry point to execute tests from tests/ after the implementation change.
